tlh.compact_term_rule: Use a compact form only when its canonical source is identified; otherwise use a transparent descriptive clause.

qya.compact_term_rule: Prefer Tolkien-attested Late Quenya; a Neo-Quenya formation requires an explicit label, derivation, and compatibility check.

safe_automation_policy: Detection and location reporting may be automated. Replacement is allowed only when an approved glossary entry and an unambiguous grammatical context both exist.

title.english_source: The Metamorphosis Code of Grace and Distance
title.rationale: The canonical Hebrew edition localizes the chapter title; it is not a protected brand or proper name.

approval_requirements: Every candidate term passes a short-label context.
Every candidate term passes a philosophical-paragraph context.
Every candidate term passes a literary-or-metaphorical context.
Every accepted term records source, profile, rejected alternatives, and rationale.
Heading-level foreign-language findings are zero unless the full phrase is an explicitly protected proper name or project brand.
An independent second linguistic review passes.
Automated clearance and release gates pass.
rules: Do not perform blind global replacement.
Do not count front matter, review gates, links, image text, citations, or intentional placeholders as translated-prose contamination.
Do not silently exempt a heading term; it requires an explicit title or proper-name policy.
Do not protect a chapter title merely because it originated in English; compare the canonical editions first.
Do not treat automated clearance as linguistic approval.
Preserve all source distinctions and publication gates during revision.
